gaps: Division presidents for most markets are not public: company releases 2023-2026 name only Stacy Conley (Dallas-Fort Worth) and Scott Sterling (Carolinas, inferred) as division presidents, and Chris Kelly as a regional president. No named president for Houston, Central Texas, Oklahoma, Minnesota (Midwest), Arizona, New Mexico, Nevada, Colorado, Utah, Washington, Oregon, Florida, Georgia/Alabama, Tennessee or the Mid-Atlantic.
Presidents of the reportable regions (Central, Southeast, Northwest, West, Florida): not named in filings or releases; only Chris Kelly (Regional President, California/West) found.

Division-level land leaders: only Joel Green (Florida, SVP) and Pat Vedra (Houston, Regional VP) are named in company sources; Seth Yurman is a snippet lead with no market. Kennon Masters (a lead in the corporate file) could not be confirmed anywhere.

Atlanta: LGI posted an open 'Vice President of Land Acquisitions and Development' role for the Atlanta market on 2026-11-13 (apply.workable.com/lgihomes), so that land seat appears vacant or newly created.
Jef Yarbrough (Division President, Carolinas, quoted 2023-01 to 2024-02) dropped: not quoted since February 2024; Scott Sterling appears to have taken the Carolinas role by 2025-05.
Terrata Homes (LGI's premium brand): no separate brand president is named; Terrata releases quote the same market VPs and Chris Kelly.
Reporting lines: LGI publishes none below the executive officers; all reports_to values here are Inferred from titles and overlapping markets.
Texas Comptroller franchise-tax records for LGI Homes, Inc. and its Texas LLCs list only corporate officers or the parent as owner (no division officers).
HBA board rosters, local business journals and conference speaker lists: not checked for division leaders.
